amendments.reason: Req 3.2 read literally mandated a false claim for fit-archive/ (re-derivability). Task 4.1 was rejected three times on emitted-text falsehoods rooted in this. Human-ratified carve-out: 3.2's re-derivability and user-owned-region elements apply only to directories holding generated documents; 3.3 governs the archive.
amendments.also: Task 4.1 emitted prose reduced to the mandated 6+1 claims; long-form editing guidance deferred to task 7.1's published contract.

amendments.reason: Task 7.2 found sync and the load engine each carrying its own local frontmatter read, functionally identical to each other and BOTH lacking the symlink refusal that audit._read_document already had -- so a symlinked workouts/*.md was refused by `check` and followed by every writer, letting a write escape the data root (Req 7.5, 7.6). The two were collapsed into src/fitdocs/docio.py, one enforcement point; deleting its refusal now fails five tests where it previously failed none. Separately, the document-format version gate was duplicated into load/engine.py because the training-load pass is itself a writer, so Req 5.5's 'left unchanged' guarantee held for the engine functions but not for the CLI commands that run that pass afterwards.
amendments.also: design.md's File Structure Plan (New Files) now lists docio.py; the LoadEngine component section now states the version-gate duplication and its requirement coverage; a fourth cross-spec integration obligation records that a writing entry point must read through docio.read_frontmatter and run the once-per-run symlink scan beside refresh_declarations; tests/test_public_api.py now pins docio's exported surface alongside contract, declaration, and audit.

amendments.reason: effort-tags spec task 4.3: effort-tags adds a second class of user-owned frontmatter key (the effort tag's four keys, contract.USER_KEYS) alongside the user-owned regions this spec already names. This spec's frontmatter-key-ownership contract is extended to cover the class generically -- publication as disjoint from the managed set, byte-for-byte carry-forward with rebuild placement, and exclusion from the unmanaged-key warning (6.3) and finding (8.4) -- while the vocabulary, validation, and typed reader of the effort tag itself remain effort-tags' own.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains Amendment 1 (2026-09-11) and Requirement 6 criteria 6.5-6.8; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note (USER_KEYS, user_owned_lines, the unmanaged_keys postcondition change) and 'This Spec Owns' gains a bullet for the user-owned key class. Nothing renumbered.

amendments.requirement: 2.11, 3.9 (new) -- implemented by the load-history spec, not by this one
amendments.reason: load-history spec task 5.5, the second half of the roadmap's Phase 6 Existing Spec Update for wiki-contract (the first half, 6.5-6.8 above, was landed by effort-tags). load-history adds a new owned data-root location (history/, history/assets/) holding one training-load history page -- a second document type distinct from the workout document this spec defines. This spec's published-ownership-contract guarantee (2.11) is extended to name the location as fitdocs-owned and to state that a second document type exists there, declared and versioned by load-history rather than by this contract; its in-tree-declaration guarantee (3.9) is extended to state what the location's own declaration says about that document -- one generated page and its chart image, rewritten in full, no user-owned region, re-derivable from the workout documents alone -- without restating the document's type or schema, which 2.11 locates. The location's write path, its declaration text, and the page's own schema remain load-history's own.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains Amendment 2 (2026-09-11), Requirement 2 criterion 2.11 and Requirement 3 criterion 3.9; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note (the second type, its declaration in fitdocs.history.page, and why it is not published from this leaf). CONTRACT_VERSION advances "2" to "3" in code by load-history task 1.2, not restated here. Nothing renumbered.

amendments.requirement: 2.12, 2.13, 3.10 (new) -- implemented by the training-blocks spec, not by this one
amendments.reason: training-blocks spec task 4.5, the roadmap's Phase 7 Existing Spec Update for wiki-contract. training-blocks adds a new owned data-root location (blocks/) holding two further document types -- the training-block page and the planned-workout page -- and a new user-owned source location, the plan-source directory, that fitdocs only reads. This spec's published-ownership-contract guarantee is extended to state that the plan-source directory is user-owned, read-only to fitdocs, located by a settings key and defaulting to a named directory, and never created, written or deleted by fitdocs (2.12); and to name the rendered blocks location as fitdocs-owned and state that it holds two further document types, declared and versioned by training-blocks rather than by this contract, naming which region of the block page is user-owned and that the planned page has none (2.13). Its in-tree-declaration guarantee is extended to state what the rendered location's own declaration says about those documents -- what the directory holds, the block page's carried-over notes region, the planned pages' lack of user-owned content, re-derivability from the plan sources alone, and that the plan sources are never written by fitdocs -- without restating either document's type or schema, which 2.13 locates (3.10). The rendered location's write path, its declaration text, and both pages' own schema remain training-blocks' own; so does the plan-source directory's resolution and confinement.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains Amendment 3 (2026-09-15), Requirement 2 criteria 2.12-2.13 and Requirement 3 criterion 3.10; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note (the two further types, their declaration in fitdocs.plans.page, and why they are not published from this leaf), and the owned-path-set bullet under 'This Spec Owns' gains a blocks/ clause plus a sentence that a configured read location grants no write right. CONTRACT_VERSION advances "3" to "4" in code by training-blocks task 1.2, not restated here. Nothing renumbered.

amendments.requirement: 2.14, 6.9 (new) -- implemented by the activity-identity spec, not by this one
amendments.reason: activity-identity spec task 6.3, its part of the roadmap's Phase 8 Existing Spec Update for wiki-contract (Amendment 4, shared with connectors and channel-merge; activity-identity created the section). activity-identity gives a workout page source roles (the base, the last entry of sources, and extras), four managed keys recording the base (source_kind, source_elapsed_s, source_distance_m, source_device), retention of a phone-side copy's session UUID, renames when the base changes, and held files recorded in .fitdocs/held.toml. This spec's published-ownership-contract guarantee is extended to state the roles, the base-recording keys, the UUID retention, renames and held files (2.14); its frontmatter-key guarantee to state that the managed key set includes the four keys (6.9). The roles, kinds, match rule, precedence setting, rename and hold remain activity-identity's own.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains Amendment 4 (2026-09-30; connectors and channel-merge append their own paragraphs to it), Requirement 2 criterion 2.14 and Requirement 6 criterion 6.9; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note. amendments.requirement: 2.15 (new) -- implemented by the connectors spec, not by this one
amendments.reason: connectors spec task 8.1, its part of the roadmap's Phase 8 Existing Spec Update for wiki-contract (Amendment 4, shared with activity-identity and channel-merge; activity-identity created the section). connectors adds two commands, fitdocs connect and fitdocs pull, that read and write beyond what regeneration already covers: a connector's credentials live one TOML file per instance in a per-user directory outside the data root, never read from or written to it; each connector's own ledger is fitdocs-owned tool state under .fitdocs/connectors/, inside the already-owned .fitdocs/ directory; pull writes its deliveries under the configured inbox and removes only its own archived, hash-identical deliveries; connect writes nothing under the data root. This spec's published-ownership-contract guarantee is extended to state where credentials live, that each ledger is fitdocs-owned tool state, and what pull and connect write and remove (2.15). The connector protocol, the transport and the credential store's resolution rules remain connectors' own.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains a connectors paragraph appended to Amendment 4 (2026-09-30) and Requirement 2 criterion 2.15; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note. CONTRACT_VERSION advances "5" to "6" in code by connectors task 8.1, not restated here. Nothing renumbered.

amendments.requirement: 2.16 (new) -- implemented by the channel-merge spec, not by this one
amendments.reason: channel-merge spec task 5.3, its part of the roadmap's Phase 8 Existing Spec Update for wiki-contract (Amendment 4, shared with activity-identity and connectors; activity-identity created the section). channel-merge makes a page's channels the composition of its archived source files: each channel from exactly one file (the base when it records the channel, otherwise the highest-ranked extra that does), identity, laps and session values the base's, a Channel Sources section naming each channel's file, and the load and benchmark passes reading the same composed activity. This spec's published-ownership-contract guarantee is extended to state the composition (2.16). The donation rule, the alignment and the section's content remain channel-merge's own.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains a channel-merge paragraph appended to Amendment 4 and Requirement 2 criterion 2.16; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note. amendments.requirement: 2.17, 3.11 (new) -- implemented by the dashboards spec, not by this one
amendments.reason: dashboards spec tasks 1.2 and 8.1, its part of the roadmap's Phase 11 Existing Spec Update for wiki-contract (Amendment 5). dashboards adds an owned location, dashboards/ and dashboards/assets/, whose pages belong to the athlete: fitdocs owns only the chart regions inside a page and the chart images and snapshot files in dashboards/assets/, never creates, rewrites as a whole or deletes a page, never modifies or deletes a snapshot, and removes a chart image only when no dashboard page references it. This is the inverse of every document type this spec named before. This spec's published-ownership-contract guarantee is extended to name the location, the dashboard page category, the chart region and asset policy, snapshots, what the dashboard pass and fitdocs dashboard overwrite, and the named exception to the index never being read back into a document (2.17); its in-tree-declaration guarantee to state what the dashboards declaration says (3.11). The page rule, the grammar, the assets and the pass remain dashboards' own.
amendments.also: requirements.md gains Amendment 5 (2026-10-13), Requirement 2 criterion 2.17 and Requirement 3 criterion 3.11; design.md's DocumentContract component gains a matching amendment note, which also records the declaration wording deviation ("a" and "after a successful index refresh" where dashboards design said "each"). No managed key added. Nothing renumbered.
